Risk Description: Incident response and vulnerability management may remain too manual without automation
Business Impact: Delayed detection response and vulnerability remediation
Remediation Plan: Expand automated alerting scanning and vulnerability workflows

Risk Description: Critical applications may not have fully tested recovery plans
Business Impact: Service disruption and extended downtime during cyber or infrastructure events
Remediation Plan: Complete DR testing for priority applications and validate backup recovery

Risk Description: AI tools may be adopted before standards usage guidance and risk controls are mature
Business Impact: Privacy security and compliance risks from unmanaged AI usage
Remediation Plan: Create AI use standards risk review checklist and user guidance

Risk Description: Data assets may lack ownership quality metadata or readiness for analytics and AI
Business Impact: Reduced data trust poor decision making and AI readiness gaps
Remediation Plan: Define data ownership metadata and stewardship requirements

Risk Description: Data tools may remain fragmented across agencies without standard onboarding and integration patterns
Business Impact: Duplicated tools inconsistent data sharing and higher operational cost
Remediation Plan: Create enterprise data tools inventory and onboarding model

Risk Description: Centralized technology offerings may lack consistent service definitions ownership and maturity tracking
Business Impact: Confusion across agencies duplicated solutions and inconsistent service quality
Remediation Plan: Build service catalog ownership model and maturity scoring process

Risk Description: Legacy on-premises footprint may remain larger than necessary due to unclear risk and dependency mapping
Business Impact: Higher cost resilience gaps and slower modernization
Remediation Plan: Map data center dependencies and prioritize rationalization candidates

Risk Description: Network voice and infrastructure consolidation may face inconsistent adoption across sites
Business Impact: Operational inefficiency duplicated support and inconsistent standards
Key Risk Indicator: Sites not onboarded to standard model
Remediation Plan: Create site consolidation tracker and standard operating model

Risk Description: Staff may use AI tools without sufficient training guidance or understanding of acceptable use
Business Impact: Data leakage inconsistent adoption and reduced trust in AI services
Remediation Plan: Develop role-based AI training and guidance materials

Risk Description: Digital services may not be consistently accessible secure and streamlined across agencies
Business Impact: Lower public trust accessibility gaps and inconsistent service delivery
Remediation Plan: Track accessibility remediation and service experience improvements

Risk Description: Vendor risk reporting may remain manual and inconsistent across secretariats
Business Impact: Limited visibility into vendor exposure and delayed compliance actions
Remediation Plan: Automate vendor risk reporting and create agency-facing compliance dashboards

Risk Description: Eligible projects may not complete PIAs consistently or early enough in planning
Business Impact: Privacy risks may be identified late causing remediation delays
Remediation Plan: Implement PIA tracking workflow and integrate with project intake
